provenance.asset_description: Starfinder Society Scenario 1-17: Corpse Fleet Conflict. The cover is two images, a large background illustration and a smaller single character overlayed above that image. The background image is First Seeker Sarmak and fellow Starfinder Zizenzi fighting off robots in front of a massive, alien starship. It’s dark, and the Starfinders are illuminated by aerial spotlights from an unknown source. The overlaying image is of a corpsefolk wearing the uniform of an officer in the Corpse Fleet casts a spell, sending a disk of condensed gravity flying through the air. She wears her stringy hair up in a tight bun and keeps her uniform pristine. Some of her teeth and a piece of her mandible are visible through the gaps in her rotting cheek.
